feature: The menu bar reads like a pro Mac editor's
summary: The menus along the top now run File, Edit, Image, Layer, then Clip and Sequence on a video, Measure, View, Window, Help. A picture no longer shows a Video menu of leftover rows, and no two rows print the same key.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/pro-menu-bar-walk.json (needs the Mac to itself: it brings the probe to the front so the menu bar reads live).

try.do: Open a picture and read along the menu bar: File, Edit, Image, Layer, Measure, View, Window, Help.
Open File ▸ Capture for Capture Region, Full Screen and Record, on their usual keys.
Press Shift Command H, then open Window: Show History is ticked.
Open a recording: Clip and Sequence appear between Layer and Measure. Open Clip.
Open Sequence: play, edits, marks, extract and lift, snapping, sound, captions.
Merge two clips from the ruler's right-click, then press Shift Command G: they come apart.
Click the timeline and press backslash: the whole video fits across it. Shift Z is Punch In.

evaluate: Does Capture as a File submenu (the way Preview files Take Screenshot) feel right, or do you want Capture back as its own menu?
Is Show History in the Window menu where you would look for the capture history?
Is the split between Clip and Sequence where a Premiere or Final Cut hand expects each row?
Should Sound (Add Sound, Export Sound) and Captions stay in Sequence, or earn their own place?
Ripple Delete moved from Option Delete (Photoshop's Fill with Foreground) to Shift Delete, the key the timeline already answered. Does that key work for you?
rough: There is no menu bar mock page to compare against; the order follows the placement contract in UX-PATTERNS and Photoshop, Premiere and Final Cut.
SwiftUI always puts its own menus after View, so the app moves View into place itself; after some rebuilds (a right-click menu closing) that happens on the next turn of the run loop.

Shift Z was two commands at once (Punch In and timeline Fit). It is Punch In now, as the punch-in mock prints; Fit moved to backslash, Premiere's key. A card asks which you want, because on 2026-09-28 you named Shift Z for Fit.
Many Clip rows read dimmed in View mode (the pictures were taken there); they come alive in Edit mode, as before.
Export Sound and the caption exports still sit in Sequence rather than under File ▸ Export; left for the every-command task, which places each row.
